source_identity.interpretation: Exact local bytes. Does not identify current deployed source or authenticate supplied model facts.

input_schema_rule: Read the selected current native catalog schema before calling evaluate_method. These hashes bind the inspected local schemas.
same_input_comparison: Compare full structured results, model fingerprint and expected errors for identical JSON inputs. Semantic transformations have separately stated expected relations.

expectation.reasoning: An award record is counted separately. Only the explicit reset reduces the accumulator; earlier threshold crossing does not imply entitlement.
Reordering identical amounts creates an invalid prefix even though their final arithmetic sum is unchanged.
The independent integer balance is 2 + 3 - 4 - 1 = 0, with release and removal kept separate.
A release of four cannot occur from a supplied opening of two before the deposit.
Numerical equality does not collapse displayed, finalized and paid states or authenticate their references.
A positive supplied payment needs its own nonblank reference field.
Independent per-account arithmetic is 8 - 3 = 5 and 1 + 3 = 4; the closed total stays nine.
Changing only the destination unit invalidates the transfer without an explicit conversion model.
A missing target field can still contain either sought value. Both unresolved references remain unknown within this supplied table.
After the final missing target becomes b, the complete supplied target set {a,b} contains neither x nor y.
Only a before b is declared. The placement of c supplies no concurrency proof.
Moving c preserves the only declared edge and should preserve conformance.
Exactly one declared control changes. An explicit empty string remains distinct from an absent observation field.
A second changed control defeats this declared single-control comparison.
Age ten is included by the supplied bound of ten, and the prior timestamp is strictly earlier.
Equal timestamps do not satisfy the strictly-earlier predicate. Missing prior evidence remains an observation boundary.
The native tuple matches while presentation and revision do not. The declaration does not authenticate or merge records.
Ownership is part of the native comparison tuple even when the locator remains equal.
The record state cannot supply a missing authority rule. An incomplete empty rule set stays unresolved.
Only the caller completeness assertion changes; its effect is a scoped declared-rule absence, not authenticated lack of authority.
Of the four Boolean assignments, only P=false,Q=false satisfies both assumptions, and it satisfies not P.
Successful examined rows cannot replace the two unexamined assignments required by this evaluator contract.
Direct reachability contains only S; the separately checked supplied U-to-B induction step still fails.
One connecting edge makes B reachable through the exact two-edge concrete witness.
The singleton and two-element explanation are both inclusion-minimal. A separately implemented exhaustive subset oracle validates the duality with cuts.
The shortcut now necessarily produces a contradicted effect, so only the longer explanation remains eligible.
(Halpha OR Hbeta) AND (Halpha OR Hgamma) has exactly the abduction model minimal families, retaining one shared Halpha.
Both actual minimal families have appeared before the final assignment, but the receipt must still disclose incomplete enumeration.
Every pure rock-paper-scissors profile admits a profitable unilateral deviation. General 3x3 mixed equilibria are outside this implementation.
Quarter and three-quarter probabilities are exactly representable. The explicit zero-mass state contributes nothing.
Player one is indifferent at five and chooses the first child; player zero then prefers eight to the safe four.
Reversing an exact tie is intentionally observable: the continuation now gives player zero zero, so safe four is chosen.
The independent balance is nine. The exactly representable residual one-eighth is included by the exactly equal declared tolerance.
The declared native tuple excludes version and label; their mismatches are explicitly separate results.
Changing native ID changes the declared tuple even if the other fields remain as before.
Determinism is keyed by state and event together. Reusing tick in A and B is valid.
The second event disagrees with B-to-A, so the third observation remains unevaluated.
False AND an unknown value is false for both possible completions of that leaf.
False OR an unknown value depends on the unobserved leaf and must remain unknown.
10*2*3 and 3*4*5 both equal sixty. The distinct factors and stable tie order remain visible.
Distinct supplied evidence IDs count as two judgments even when their source reference is shared. The method computes no independence, probability or truth score.
Repeated source references are permitted, but repeated evidence IDs are not distinct records.
Every supplied row being supported does not prove full pack coverage, resolved references or storage.
A supported caller record requires at least one declared source reference.
